versions.content: The function FrTrcv_MainFunction shall scan all busses in STANDBY and SLEEP for wake up events and store them internally. Note: EcuM will invoke EcuM_CheckWakeup. This results in the invocation of FrTrcv_CheckWakeupByTransceiver. So, in case of POLLING, the API FrTrcv_CheckWakeupByTransceiver shall invoke the EcuM_SetWakeupEvent.
